A. System Functionality
The system successfully accepts and processes PDF files. The chatbot correctly retrieves information from the uploaded PDF. The chatbot answers are relevant to the questions asked. The system avoids answering outside the provided document. The response time is acceptable. B.

Usability
The interface is easy to use. The workflow (upload → ask → answer) is clear. The system provides understandable responses. The chatbot is suitable for non-technical users. The system can be used without training.

(if it option was selected from page 1)
IT PROFESSIONAL Questions
These focus on deployment, reliability, and performance. The system is technically stable during operation. The system can handle multiple queries without crashing. The system is suitable for real-world deployment. The file handling and processing is efficient. The system architecture is appropriate for enterprise use. (if CS option was selected from page 1)
COMPUTER SCIENCE Expert Questions
These validate AI + RAG correctness. The retrieval mechanism returns relevant document segments.

The RAG approach improves answer accuracy. The LLM integrates well with the vector database. The system reduces hallucination compared to standard chatbots. The design follows good AI engineering practices. (if Historian option was selected from page 1)
Historian Expert Questions
These validate content trust and historical correctness.

The chatbot accurately reflects the content of the uploaded history PDF. The answers preserve historical meaning and context. The chatbot does not invent historical facts. The chatbot is useful for historical research.
The system can help students understand history documents.
